name: latex-hw-format
description: Formats LaTeX homework using a consistent title page, current/total page numbering, and structured problem/solution layout.

interface.longDescription: Formats LaTeX homework in the preferred HW-1/HW-3 house style, including title-page formatting, current/total page numbering, per-problem chapter labels, Question/Solution blocks, numbered solution steps, and horizontal problem separators.
defaultPrompt: Reformat this LaTeX homework to match my HW-1/HW-3 house style.
Create a polished LaTeX homework file using my standard homework format.
